entities.summary: James Robert McGinn IV is a Canadian former professional ice hockey forward who played in the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the second round, 36th overall, by the San Jose Sharks of the 2006 NHL entry draft. He skated in over 600 NHL games.
